current_text: From Spook Studio. Ah, good catch! I had previously set it up so that if you ever touched the collage, it permanently deactivated the tease. I've just removed that permanent block! Now, every single time you scroll away from the collage and scroll back to it, it will faithfully perform that 150px slide exactly 0.2 seconds after entering the screen—guaranteeing the user always knows they can swipe it, regardless of if they've swiped it before. (It tracks your finger/mouse now, so it will still be smart enough not to fire the tease if you are actively holding it when it comes into view). It should feel completely consistent now!
